title: QA Tester – Sitecore AI Web Testing & Automation
description:
**Job Family****:**

Software Application & Development (India)

**Travel Required****:**

None

**Clearance Required****:**

None

**What You Will Do:**

We are seeking a QA Tester to ensure the quality, functionality, accessibility, and performance of websites built on Sitecore AI and related digital experience technologies. In this role, you will plan and execute manual and automated testing across web pages, components, forms, content workflows, APIs, integrations, and releases. You will work closely with developers, content authors, product owners, designers, and delivery partners to identify defects early, expand automated test coverage, and deliver reliable, secure, and user-friendly digital experiences across browsers, devices, and environments.

* Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Sitecore AI websites, features, components, forms, content updates, integrations, and releases.
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration, end-to-end, cross-browser, responsive, accessibility, performance, and visual testing across supported environments.
* Build, maintain, and improve automated tests for critical website journeys, reusable components, APIs, and regression scenarios using modern web test automation frameworks.
* Validate Sitecore AI authoring experiences, page and component configuration, content publishing, personalization, search, forms, analytics tagging, consent behavior, and third-party integrations.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and review results to support release readiness and rapid defect detection.
* Document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, screenshots or logs, severity, and business impact; verify fixes through retesting and regression testing.
* Partner with developers, designers, content teams, and product owners to clarify acceptance criteria, identify test risks, and improve testability early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Create and maintain reusable automation utilities, page objects, test fixtures, test data, and reporting that improve test reliability and reduce manual effort.
* Track test execution, automation coverage, defect trends, escaped defects, and release quality metrics, and communicate findings and risks clearly to stakeholders.
* Contribute to quality standards, test documentation, peer reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of website testing practices.

**What You Will Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* At least 4 years of experience in software quality assurance, with hands-on responsibility for testing websites or web applications in enterprise environments.
* Strong knowledge of QA methods, the software development lifecycle, test design techniques, defect management, risk-based testing, and release validation.
* Hands-on experience creating and maintaining web test automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, or equivalent technologies.
* Proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript and working knowledge of another scripting or programming language such as Python, Java, or C#.
* Experience testing modern websites and web applications, including responsive layouts, reusable components, navigation, search, forms, content publishing, APIs, and third-party integrations.
* Experience with API testing tools and techniques, including request validation, response validation, authentication, error handling, and integration scenarios.
* Experience with Git-based workflows, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, automated test execution, test reporting, and quality gates.
* Ability to use browser developer tools, logs, network traces, and test evidence to isolate and communicate website defects effectively.
* Experience validating cross-browser and cross-device behavior, accessibility, performance, security-related requirements, analytics tagging, and production readiness.
* Ability to write clear test cases, automation code, defect reports, test summaries, and release-quality recommendations.
* Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a hybrid, cross-functional delivery environment.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, review test assets, troubleshoot failures, and share testing and automation knowledge with team members.

**What Would Be Nice to Have:**

* Hands-on testing experience with Sitecore AI, Sitecore XM Cloud, Experience Edge, or another composable digital experience platform.
* Experience testing React and Next.js websites deployed through Vercel, Microsoft Azure, or another cloud platform.
* Experience with Selenium, REST clients, accessibility testing tools, visual regression tools, and performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6.
* Experience designing maintainable automation frameworks using page objects, fixtures, data-driven testing, mocking, parallel execution, retry strategies, and actionable reporting.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jira, test management platforms, and browser or device testing services.
* Relevant certification in Sitecore, software testing, test automation, accessibility, cloud technologies, or web quality engineering.
* Experience testing high-traffic, multilingual, personalized, or regulated enterprise websites and coordinating quality activities with distributed delivery teams.

Job Title: Marketo QA Engineer

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented Marketo QA Engineer to ensure the accuracy, functionality, and quality of marketing campaigns, automation workflows, data processes, and platform integrations. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience validating Marketo campaign configurations, email programs, smart lists, lead data, and integrations with Salesforce or other marketing platforms.

The role requires strong analytical skills, systematic test execution, and the ability to identify campaign, workflow, and data issues before production activation.

Roles and Responsibilities

**1. Campaign and Email Quality Assurance**

* Validate email content, hyperlinks, images, personalization tokens, and dynamic content.
* Test nurture campaigns, triggered campaigns, wait steps, flow actions, and conditional logic.
* Verify A/B testing configurations, audience allocation, and campaign variants.
* Test landing pages and forms, including field validation, submission handling, and confirmation messages.
* Check email rendering across browsers, devices, and email clients.

**2. Marketo Program and Workflow Testing**

* Validate event registration, confirmation emails, reminders, and post-event follow-up workflows.
* Verify smart lists, segmentation criteria, audience counts, and program membership.
* Test form-to-program flows, lead capture, routing, and campaign progression.
* Validate content syndication feeds, field mappings, and data synchronization.
* Confirm that campaign logic meets the defined business requirements before activation.

**3. Data Quality and Validation**

* Validate lead and contact uploads for completeness, correct formatting, mandatory fields, and duplicates.
* Verify data normalization, field values, and list counts against expected results.
* Identify data inconsistencies before campaign execution.
* Use Excel and basic SQL, where applicable, to validate records and investigate data discrepancies.
* Verify that campaign and lead data remain consistent across connected platforms.

**4. Integration and Platform Testing**

* Validate Marketo-to-Salesforce synchronization, field mappings, and data consistency.
* Test API-based integrations and manual data exchanges with external platforms.
* Verify third-party email HTML, tracking links, and campaign data transfers.
* Document integration failures, investigate root causes, and coordinate resolution with technical teams.

**5. Test Documentation and Defect Management**

* Prepare and execute test cases, test scenarios, and regression test suites.
* Record defects with clear reproduction steps, expected results, actual results, and supporting evidence.
* Perform retesting after fixes and validate business-critical workflows before release.
* Collaborate with marketing operations, campaign managers, developers, and business stakeholders in Agile or sprint-based environments.

Required Qualifications

* 2+ years of relevant QA experience, preferably in marketing automation or MarTech platforms.
* Hands-on knowledge of Adobe Marketo Engage, including campaigns, smart lists, program flows, and segmentation.
* Experience testing email campaigns, landing pages, forms, and marketing automation workflows.
* Understanding of lead data validation, deduplication, field mapping, and platform integrations.
* Basic SQL and Excel skills for data verification.
* HTML fundamentals for email validation, link inspection, and form troubleshooting.
* Strong attention to detail, test case documentation, defect reporting, and regression testing.

Good to Have

* Salesforce CRM and Marketo integration testing experience.
* API testing and third-party data integration validation.
* Exposure to performance or load testing.
* Experience with Jira or similar defect-tracking tools.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery and sprint-based QA.
